terminology.details: I can attach each name to its job: RGB is the three color channels; a tensor shape describes arranged numeric axes; modality is a source of information; DIRECT marks a direct answer; EOS is the ending ID. numbers_and_symbols.48: Four by four blocks times three RGB channels gives 48 scalar picture-summary entries.
numbers_and_symbols.16: The sound summary has one entry per frequency band after averaging its frames; losing frame order limits its use to these pure tones.
numbers_and_symbols.64: Each modality summary becomes a feature of width 64 at one context position.
numbers_and_symbols.264: The final logits axis has 264 candidate next IDs, distinct from the number of positions or feature width.
numbers_and_symbols.440_and_880_Hz: These are approximately the two groups of vibrations per second in this capstone, not universal low/high definitions.
numbers_and_symbols.x_over_y_and_pairs: Answer x/y counts x whole correct answers out of y tested records. Pair x/y requires both the original and changed records to be correct; joint whole correctness also requires both components.
